text_en: 2 tbsp oil, fry garlic on low heat
cue_en: Garlic edges turn pale gold
수솊 대사: 마늘이 연한 금색이에요. 이제 양파 넣어요.
say_en: Garlic's pale gold. Add the onion now.

text_en: Add onion, cook until translucent
Add chicken, sear the outside
cue_en: Underside of the chicken coating darkens
수솊 대사: 아래가 다시 바삭해졌어요. 한 번 뒤집어요.
say_en: The bottom's crisp again. Flip it once.

text_en: Add rice, press flat and fry
수솊이 보는 신호: 팬 바닥에서 타닥 소리가 커짐, 밥알 가장자리 갈색
cue_en: Crackling gets louder, rice edges brown
수솊 대사: 바닥이 눌기 직전이에요. 한 번 뒤섞어요.
say_en: It's about to stick. Toss it once.

text_en: Season with ⅓ tbsp salt

내용: 찬 팬에 기름과 마늘 넣고 약불로 켜기
text_en: Put oil and garlic in a cold pan, then turn on low heat
Fry until the garlic turns golden
cue_en: Garlic is golden and the bubbling slows
say_en: It's golden now. Any longer and it turns bitter.

text_en: Add rice, press flat and fry
cue_en: Crackling gets louder
say_en: Toss it before it sticks.

내용: 팬 가장자리에 간장 ½숟가락 둘러 눌리기
text_en: Drizzle ½ tbsp soy sauce around the edge of the pan
Top with a fried egg (optional)
Oil the pan, stir-fry the onion on medium heat
Add chicken, warm one side
수솊이 보는 신호: 아랫면 튀김옷이 다시 바삭, 색이 진해짐
cue_en: Coating on the underside crisps up and darkens
say_en: Flip it now. Just once.

text_en: Pour in the sauce and toss quickly
cue_en: Sauce starts bubbling
say_en: The sauce is boiling. Turn it down and toss.

text_en: Turn off the heat when the sauce is almost gone
Melt butter, cook the onion on medium-low heat

내용: 양파가 갈색이 될 때까지 계속 볶기
text_en: Keep cooking until the onion turns brown
수솊이 보는 신호: 양파가 진한 갈색, 바닥에 갈색 막
cue_en: Onion is deep brown, brown film on the pot
수솊 대사: 이 갈색이 맛이에요. 바닥에 물 조금 부어 긁어요.
say_en: That brown is the flavor. Add a splash of water and scrape the bottom.

text_en: Add 300 ml water and soy sauce, bring to a boil
cue_en: Foam rises at the edge of the pot
say_en: It's boiling. Turn it down to low.

text_en: Simmer 10 min on low, season with salt and pepper
Top with bread and cheese (optional)

내용: 기름 두르고 약불로 파 볶아 파기름 내기
text_en: Oil the pan, fry green onion on low heat for scallion oil
cue_en: Green onion edges just about to brown
say_en: Almost golden. Pour in the egg.

내용: 계란 붓고 반쯤 익으면 바로 밥 넣기
text_en: Pour in the egg, add rice as soon as it's half set
cue_en: Egg is half set, still wet
수솊 대사: 반만 익었을 때 밥 넣어요. 지금이에요.
say_en: Add the rice while it's half cooked. Now.

text_en: Press the rice flat and stir-fry
cue_en: Crackling gets louder
say_en: Toss it before it sticks.

text_en: Season with ½ tbsp soy sauce and salt

내용: 기름 두르고 중불로 김치와 설탕 볶기
text_en: Oil the pan, stir-fry kimchi and sugar on medium heat
cue_en: Kimchi turns translucent, edges darken slightly
say_en: Kimchi's translucent. Time for the rice.

text_en: Add chili flakes and fry for just 10 sec
cue_en: Chili flakes darken as they hit the oil
say_en: Chili flakes burn fast. Turn it down.

text_en: Add rice, press flat and fry
cue_en: Crackling gets louder
say_en: The bottom's about to stick.

text_en: Turn off the heat, drizzle sesame oil and mix
Top with a fried egg (optional)

내용: 기름 두르고 중불에 양념한 고기 펼쳐 넣기
text_en: Oil the pan, spread the marinated pork on medium heat

내용: 고기 겉이 하얗게 익을 때까지 볶기
text_en: Stir-fry until the outside of the pork turns white
cue_en: Pink is gone, edges browning
say_en: Almost no pink left. Add the onion.

text_en: Add the onion and stir-fry
수솊이 보는 신호: 양념이 바닥에 진하게 눌기 시작, 연기
cue_en: Sauce sticks dark to the pan, smoke
say_en: Gochujang burns fast. Down to medium-low.

text_en: Add green onion for 1 min, finish with sesame oil
cue_en: Green onion just wilts
say_en: Done. Turn it off.

내용: 기름 없이 팬에 대패삼겹 펼쳐 굽기
text_en: Spread the pork belly in a dry pan and cook
cue_en: Edges brown, fat pools in the pan
say_en: Plenty of fat now. Add the kimchi.

내용: 고기 기름에 김치와 설탕 넣고 볶기
text_en: Stir-fry kimchi and sugar in the pork fat
Stir-fry until the kimchi is translucent
cue_en: Pan bottom starts to stick dark
say_en: About to burn. Turn it down.

text_en: Finish with sesame oil
Oil the pan, heat on medium
Add the egg
cue_en: White edges set and sizzle
say_en: The edges are set. Turn it down to low.

내용: 흰자가 다 하얘지면 불 끄기 (반숙) / 1분 더 (완숙)
text_en: Turn off when the white is set (runny) / 1 more min (well done)
cue_en: Clear white over the yolk turns white
수솊 대사: 흰자 다 익었어요. 반숙이면 지금 꺼요.
say_en: Whites are cooked. Turn it off now for a runny yolk.

text_en: Melt butter on low heat
cue_en: Butter foam starts turning brown
수솊 대사: 버터가 타기 직전이에요. 바로 계란 부어요.
say_en: Butter's about to burn. Pour in the eggs now.

text_en: Pour in the eggs, push in big strokes with a spatula
Turn off at 80% done
cue_en: Soft curds, surface still glossy
say_en: Turn it off now. The leftover heat will finish it.

text_en: Fry an egg with a runny yolk
cue_en: White set, yolk still domed
say_en: Runny yolk. Move it onto the rice now.

text_en: Put the egg and butter on the warm rice
Drizzle soy sauce and sesame oil, then mix
Oil the pan, heat on medium
Lay the tofu in and leave it alone
수솊이 보는 신호: 아랫면 가장자리가 노릇, 팬에서 저절로 떨어짐
cue_en: Underside edges golden, releases from the pan
수솊 대사: 가장자리가 노릇해요. 이제 뒤집어도 안 부서져요.
say_en: Edges are golden. It won't break if you flip now.

text_en: Flip and brown the other side
cue_en: Both sides golden brown
say_en: Both sides done.

text_en: Serve with soy dipping sauce (optional)

내용: 기름 두르고 계란 부어 반만 익혀 꺼내두기
text_en: Oil the pan, cook the egg halfway and set it aside
cue_en: Edges puff, center still wet
say_en: Half done. Move it to a bowl now.

text_en: Stir-fry the tomato in the same pan
cue_en: Skins peel and juice comes out
say_en: Juice is out. Add the egg back.

text_en: Return the egg, season with sugar and salt

내용: 크게 한두 번만 섞고 불 끄기
text_en: Fold once or twice, then turn off
Stir-fry onion and sausage, add 2 tbsp ketchup
cue_en: Ketchup starts sticking to the pan
say_en: The ketchup's about to stick. Add the rice.

text_en: Add rice, stir-fry, and plate it
Wipe the pan, melt butter on low heat
Pour in the egg and cook just the edges
cue_en: Edges set, center still runny
수솊 대사: 가운데가 아직 촉촉할 때 불 꺼요.
say_en: Turn it off while the center's still soft.

내용: 계란을 밥 위에 덮고 케찹 뿌리기
text_en: Lay the egg over the rice, top with ketchup

내용: 기름 얇게 두르고 약불에 계란물 ⅓ 붓기
text_en: Thin layer of oil, pour in ⅓ of the egg on low heat
cue_en: Egg puffs and sizzles right away
say_en: Too hot. Turn it down to low.

text_en: When the top is half set, roll from one end
cue_en: Top 70% set, edges lifting
수솊 대사: 지금 말아요. 더 익으면 안 붙어요.
say_en: Roll now. Any later and it won't stick.

내용: 빈 자리에 남은 계란물 부어 이어 말기
text_en: Pour the rest of the egg into the empty space and keep rolling
Once rolled, turn it to cook the outside
수솊이 보는 신호: 겉면 연한 노란색 유지, 갈색 반점 없음
cue_en: Outside stays pale yellow, no brown spots
say_en: Done. Let it cool 2 min before slicing.

text_en: Scramble the eggs and set aside
cue_en: Soft curds, still moist
say_en: Set them aside.

text_en: Fry the garlic, then add the spinach
cue_en: Garlic smells fragrant, pale gold
say_en: Add the spinach.

내용: 시금치 숨이 죽으면 계란 넣고 소금 간
text_en: When the spinach wilts, add the egg and season with salt
cue_en: Spinach halves in volume, deep green
say_en: It's wilted. Turn it off right away.

text_en: Sear the Spam in a dry pan on medium heat
cue_en: Underside deep brown, sizzling
say_en: It's browned. Flip it.

text_en: Sear the other side
cue_en: Both sides brown
say_en: Done.

text_en: Lay it on rice with a fried egg and mayo
Roll the sausages around the pan first
cue_en: Cuts open up, outside browns
say_en: The cuts opened. Add the veggies.

text_en: Add the vegetables and stir-fry
Add the sauce and reduce
cue_en: Sauce turns sticky, starts clinging to the pan
say_en: The sauce is about to stick. Turn it off.

text_en: Oil the pan, heat on medium-low
Lay the zucchini in and cook
수솊이 보는 신호: 계란옷 가장자리가 노릇, 윗면 계란이 굳음
cue_en: Egg coating edges golden, top egg set
say_en: Edges are golden. Flip.

text_en: Cook the other side
수솊이 보는 신호: 양면 연한 노란빛, 갈색 반점 약간
cue_en: Both sides pale yellow, a few brown spots
say_en: Done.

text_en: Plenty of oil, heat on medium

내용: 감자채를 얇고 넓게 펴서 꾹 누르기
text_en: Spread the potato thin and wide, press down
Brown the underside
수솊이 보는 신호: 가장자리 갈색, 팬을 흔들면 통째로 미끄러짐
cue_en: Edges brown, slides as one piece when you shake the pan
say_en: It moves as one piece. Time to flip.

내용: 기름 조금 더 두르고 반대쪽 굽기
text_en: Add a little more oil, cook the other side
cue_en: Both sides crisp and brown, the sizzle quiets
say_en: Crispy. Turn it off.

text_en: Plenty of oil, heat on medium
Spread the batter thin
수솊이 보는 신호: 가장자리가 바삭한 갈색, 윗면 반죽이 반 이상 익음
cue_en: Edges crisp and brown, top more than half set
say_en: Edges are crisp. Flip.

text_en: Flip and press down with the spatula
Crisp the other side
cue_en: Both sides brown, the sizzle gets quieter
say_en: Done.

text_en: Melt butter on low heat
cue_en: Butter foam starts turning brown
say_en: Butter's about to burn. Lay the bread in.

text_en: Cook the soaked bread
cue_en: Underside deep golden
say_en: Nice color. Flip.

text_en: Cook the other side
cue_en: Both sides golden, springy when pressed
say_en: Done.

내용: 팬에 버터 녹이고 익힌 감자 넣기
text_en: Melt butter, add the cooked potatoes
Roll them around to brown the outside
cue_en: Each side golden brown
say_en: That side's golden. Roll them.

text_en: Season with salt, sugar, pepper and turn off
cue_en: All sides golden
say_en: Done.

내용: 중불에서 버섯을 기름 없이 펼쳐 굽기
text_en: Spread mushrooms in a dry pan on medium heat
cue_en: Underside browns, released water cooks off
say_en: They've browned. Flip now.

text_en: Add butter and garlic, toss
cue_en: Butter foam turns brown
say_en: Butter's in. Turn it down.

내용: 간장 한 바퀴 두르고 불 끄기
text_en: Drizzle soy sauce around and turn off
Skin side down, cook on medium-low
Leave it until the skin is crisp
수솊이 보는 신호: 껍질 노릇한 갈색, 옆면 ⅔가 하얗게 익음
cue_en: Skin golden brown, ⅔ of the side turns white
say_en: ⅔ of the side is cooked. Flip.

text_en: Flip, cover, cook 3 min
수솊이 보는 신호: 두꺼운 부분 투명한 육즙, 분홍색 없음
cue_en: Clear juices at the thickest part, no pink
say_en: Cooked through.

text_en: (Optional) Add the sauce and reduce
cue_en: Sauce turns sticky, bubbles get bigger
say_en: The sauce has reduced. Turn it off.

text_en: Oil the pan, brown the bottoms
cue_en: Bottoms golden brown
say_en: Bottoms are golden. Add water.

text_en: Add 3 tbsp water and cover right away
cue_en: Hissing, pan fills with steam
say_en: Turn it down to low and leave it.

내용: 물이 다 날아가면 뚜껑 열어 바삭하게
text_en: When the water's gone, uncover and crisp
cue_en: Water sound changes to an oil sizzle
수솊 대사: 물 소리가 기름 소리로 바뀌었어요. 다 됐어요.
say_en: The water sound turned to sizzling. Done.

text_en: 1 cm oil in the pan, heat on medium
수솊이 보는 신호: 빵가루 한 알이 바로 떠오르며 거품
cue_en: A breadcrumb floats up right away with bubbles
수솊 대사: 기름이 준비됐어요. 돈가스 넣고 중약불로 줄여요.
say_en: Oil's ready. Add the cutlet and turn it to medium-low.

text_en: Add the cutlet, fry one side
cue_en: Coating edges turn golden
say_en: It's golden. Flip.

text_en: Fry the other side
수솊이 보는 신호: 양면 황금 갈색, 거품이 작아지고 소리가 높아짐
cue_en: Both sides golden brown, bubbles shrink, the sound gets higher
say_en: The bubbles got small. Take it out.

text_en: Stand it on paper towels to drain
Bring 550 ml water to a boil
cue_en: Big bubbles keep rising
say_en: Water's boiling. Add the noodles and soup base.

text_en: Add noodles and soup base, 2 min
cue_en: Foam reaches the rim of the pot
say_en: About to boil over. Turn it down a bit.

text_en: Add the egg, don't stir
Turn off at 4 min total
cue_en: Noodles loosen, broth turns cloudy
say_en: That's 4 minutes. For chewy noodles, now.

text_en: Oil the pot, stir-fry the pork and kimchi
cue_en: Kimchi translucent, pork white outside
say_en: Kimchi's translucent. Add the water.

text_en: Add 300 ml water, chili flakes and sugar, bring to a boil
cue_en: Foam reaches the edge
say_en: Turn it to medium-low before it boils over.

text_en: Simmer 10 min on medium-low
Add tofu and green onion, 3 more min
cue_en: Tofu takes on the broth's color
say_en: Done.

내용: 물 300ml에 된장 풀고 감자 넣어 끓이기
text_en: Dissolve doenjang in 300 ml water, add potato, boil
cue_en: Foam rises to the edge
say_en: Before it boils over — turn it down to medium.

text_en: Add zucchini, onion and garlic, 5 min
Add tofu and chili, 3 min
cue_en: Zucchini translucent, a chopstick slides into the potato
say_en: Done.

text_en: Dissolve the sauce in 250 ml water, bring to a boil
cue_en: Sauce bubbling hard
say_en: It's boiling. Add the rice cakes.

text_en: Add rice cakes and fish cake, reduce on medium
수솊이 보는 신호: 국물이 걸쭉, 떡이 바닥에 붙기 시작
cue_en: Sauce thickens, rice cakes start sticking to the bottom
say_en: It's sticking. Stir once.

text_en: When the sauce is halved, add the green onion
cue_en: Thick enough to coat the rice cakes
say_en: That's it. Turn it off.

text_en: Oil the pan, stir-fry fish cake and onion
cue_en: Fish cake edges lightly golden
say_en: Lightly golden. Add the sauce.

text_en: Add the sauce and reduce
수솊이 보는 신호: 양념이 거의 없어지고 바닥에 붙기 시작
cue_en: Sauce almost gone, starting to stick
say_en: The sauce is reduced. Turn it off.

text_en: Finish with sesame oil
Sear the potatoes in oil
cue_en: Potato surface turns translucent
say_en: The outside is translucent. Pour in the sauce.

text_en: Pour in the sauce, cover, 10 min on medium-low
cue_en: Foam pushes out from under the lid
say_en: It's about to overflow. Crack the lid.

text_en: Uncover and reduce the sauce
cue_en: Sauce almost gone, crackling from the bottom
say_en: About to burn. Turn it off.

내용: 물 1L에 소금 넣고 면 삶기 (봉지 시간 -1분)
text_en: Salt 1 L water, cook pasta (package time −1 min)
cue_en: Foam rises over the pot
say_en: Boiling over. Turn it down a little.

내용: 면물 한 컵 떠두고 면 건지기
text_en: Save a cup of pasta water, drain

내용: 팬에 올리브유와 마늘 넣고 약불로 켜기
text_en: Olive oil and garlic in the pan, then turn on low
cue_en: Garlic pale gold, bubbles get smaller
수솊 대사: 연한 금색이에요. 고추 넣고 바로 면물 부어요.
say_en: Pale gold. Add the chili, then the pasta water right away.

내용: 면물 ½컵과 면 넣고 흔들며 섞기
text_en: Add ½ cup pasta water and the pasta, shake to mix
cue_en: Sauce turns milky and clings to the pasta
say_en: The sauce is clinging. Done.

text_en: Stir-fry bacon and onion in butter
cue_en: Bacon edges crisp, onion translucent
say_en: Good. Pour in the milk.

text_en: Pour in the milk and warm it
cue_en: Small bubbles ring the edge
say_en: Milk boils over fast. Turn it to low.

text_en: Add pasta and cheese, reduce
수솊이 보는 신호: 소스가 숟가락 뒷면에 묻을 만큼 걸쭉
cue_en: Sauce coats the back of a spoon
say_en: That's thick enough. Turn it off.

text_en: Season with salt and pepper
Stir-fry the meat and vegetables on high heat
수솊이 보는 신호: 양배추 숨이 반쯤 죽고 가장자리 갈색
cue_en: Cabbage half wilted, edges brown
say_en: Veggies are half done. Add the noodles.

text_en: Add noodles and sauce, toss quickly
수솊이 보는 신호: 면이 팬에 붙고 소스가 눌기 시작
cue_en: Noodles cling to the pan, sauce starts sticking
say_en: It's sticking. Keep lifting and tossing.

내용: 소스가 면에 다 배면 불 끄기
text_en: Turn off once the noodles soak up the sauce
cue_en: No liquid left on the pan
say_en: Done.

text_en: Scramble the egg and set aside
cue_en: Soft curds, still moist
say_en: Set them aside.

내용: 같은 팬에 참치·간장 소스 넣고 30초 볶기
text_en: In the same pan, stir-fry tuna with the soy sauce for 30 sec
cue_en: Soy sauce starts sticking
say_en: About to stick. Turn it off.

text_en: Top the rice with egg, tuna and mayo
